frozen_scientific_scope.original_scope: Bilaterally symmetrical rounded coil with an expanding flared aperture. Retain observed flared lip, not a bare steinkern, ammonite or generic spiral. No soft parts.

scale.evidence: Each primary photo includes1cm scale. P888970 approximate projected specimen22.6×28.6mm; P88897330.4×28.4mm. Measurement is image-derived, not a published caliper dimension. See private/scale-readback.json.
scale.engineering_tolerance: Approximate width28–33mm, depth21–26mm, height27–31mm; not biological confidence intervals. Perspective and damaged margins limit precision.

uncertainty: Opposite lateral flank is not independently photographed; underlying bilateral shell architecture is inferred. Do not claim exact symmetrical damage.

Depth of interior is obscured by mineral fill and museum labels. Model only a shallow visibly recessed filled region, not unseen internal lumen or chambers. Label removal is a simplified neutral unlettered surface, not reconstruction of hidden diagnostic details.

The right lip is broken and the full original slit/outer lip cannot be measured. Do not restore an elaborate intact median slit or enlarged completed trumpet. Bound shape by preserved lip and conservative neighboring curvature.

Fine ornament, unseen back surface and palette are simplified. Source photos are noncommercial reference media; use scientific proportions/anatomy only, no mesh extraction, tracing or photo derivative textures.
